summary: Reuters-backed reporting said Thomson Reuters would cut up to 500 engineering roles globally as the company aggressively deploys artificial intelligence across its businesses and shifts hiring toward senior, AI-native engineering roles.
evidenceQuote: Thomson Reuters, the Canadian parent company behind Reuters News, is cutting up to 500 engineering jobs, joining a long list of technology providers shedding parts of their workforce in preference for AI.
notes: Silicon Republic cited and linked the Reuters report, saying the cuts could affect about 1.8% of Thomson Reuters' global workforce and about 5.2% of its operations and technology unit. This is classified as explicit AI cited because the reported rationale is tied to AI deployment and AI-native hiring, not because the source says every cut role was directly replaced by AI.
